outcome: percentage of women who agree to PPIUCD insertion
factors linked to the acceptance of PPIUCD insertion
cohort: 200 women who underwent Postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Device insertion (PPIUCD), received counselling, provided written consent, and met specific inclusion and exclusion criteria.
finding: The study found that PPIUCD insertion rate was 5.5% among total deliveries, with high acceptance (54%) among women with 2nd parity, and majority of insertions (54.5%) done intra-operatively during cesarean section.
mod_finding: 54.5% of PPIUCD insertions were done intra-operatively during cesarean section, while 23.5% were done immediately after vaginal delivery and another 22% within 48 hours of vaginal delivery.
